title: Program Control Flow with Avatar
summary: This module implements an agentic control flow using the Avatar class. It iteratively decides on actions, executes tools, and dynamically updates its internal state until a task is completed.

nodes.label: Avatar Module
nodes.title: Avatar Orchestrator
nodes.description: The central orchestrator, `Avatar`, manages an iterative agentic loop. It processes a task by repeatedly deciding on actions, executing tools, and adapting its strategy until the task is completed.

nodes.label: Actor Predictor
nodes.title: Action Decision Maker
nodes.description: An internal DSPy `TypedPredictor` that acts as the agent's brain. It interprets the current goal and available tools to decide the next best action to take, including when to finish.

nodes.label: Actor Signature
nodes.title: Actor's Instruction Set
nodes.description: Defines the prompt structure and expected inputs/outputs for the `Actor` predictor. It specifies the task `goal`, available `tools`, and the format for the `action` to be generated.

nodes.label: Initial Task Signature
nodes.title: Task Definition
nodes.description: The initial `dspy.Signature` provided by the user, which defines the overall problem statement, required inputs, and the desired format for the final output of the `Avatar` module.

nodes.label: Dynamically Update Signature
nodes.title: Adaptive Prompting
nodes.description: A crucial mechanism within `Avatar` that dynamically modifies the `Actor`'s signature. It incorporates past actions and their results, effectively adapting the prompt to guide the agent's subsequent decisions.

nodes.label: Execute Selected Tool
nodes.title: Tool Invocation
nodes.description: The process of invoking a specific external tool chosen by the `Actor`. It passes the tool's input query and captures the tool's output, which is then used to inform the next decision cycle.

nodes.label: External Tools
nodes.title: Available Tools
nodes.description: A collection of predefined functions or modules that the `Avatar` agent can call upon. These tools perform specific operations, providing capabilities beyond the LLM's direct reasoning.

nodes.label: Generate Final Prediction
nodes.title: Task Completion
nodes.description: The ultimate output generated by the `Avatar` module once the `Actor` decides the task is complete. It conforms to the module's output signature and includes a record of all actions taken.

groups.label: Orchestration & Control
groups.title: Main Agentic Loop Management
groups.description: Handles the overall flow, initialization, and termination of the iterative task-solving process.

groups.label: Agentic Decision Loop
groups.title: Iterative Action Generation
groups.description: Components responsible for making decisions, adapting the agent's prompt, and guiding the next steps based on the current state and goal.

groups.label: Tool Interaction
groups.title: External Capability Integration
groups.description: Manages the invocation of external tools and processing their results to extend the agent's capabilities beyond pure language model reasoning.

groups.label: Task Definition & Output
groups.title: Input/Output Data Structures
groups.description: Defines the initial problem statement for the agent and structures the final, completed output of the task.
